user_questions.question: When a menu item has no allergen information recorded yet, should the customer filter treat it as safe and show it, or hide it whenever an allergen filter is on? Options: (a) show it, labelled 'Allergens not provided' (recommended; the 206 existing items are all blank, so hiding would empty the menu until backfilled); (b) hide it whenever any allergen filter is selected, which needs an 'allergens reviewed' flag.
user_questions.simulated_answer: No preference; use your recommended default.
